'''Bertriak''' was a manufacturing company that produced active [[Sensor jammer/Legends|jamming systems]] for [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. One of their products was the [["Screamer" active jammer]] installed in [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="SWS" />
